title: Venezuelan Sevaiiya Noodles Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry made with Sevaiiya noodles, yellow peppers, and a hint of roasted spices.

ingredients.name: Yellow pepper
ingredients.notes: any color bell pepper can be used

ingredients.name: Venezuelan roasted spices
ingredients.notes: available at most Latin American grocery stores

instructions: Cook Sevaiiya noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the yellow pepper and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until slightly softened.
Add the roasted peanuts and cook for an additional minute.
Add the Venezuelan roasted spices and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the pepper and spice mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Optional: Serve with additional roasted peanuts or a sprinkle of queso fresco for garnish.
